results.testId: /  / product-behaviours.spec.mjs / live ordinary comment recovery confirms the existing source result without resending

given: The acting GitHub user has current issue comment authority
The repository supports ordinary comments distinct from continuation
examples.when: The operator explicitly confirms an ordinary comment
then: The conversation contains the confirmed GitHub comment identity
The comment is attributed to the verified GitHub user
The action does not request continuation
examples.limitations: Fixture confirmation does not establish a GitHub App-user effect. Live confirmation requires an explicit selected issue and source write opt-in.

given: The operator confirmed an ordinary comment

then: The original comment intent remains identified
Lighthouse Control Center does not silently post another comment
The outcome remains uncertain until source evidence confirms it
examples.limitations: Fixture-backed loss injection and live recovery contribute different evidence. The live case requires an exact existing comment ID and performs no prepare or submit; the separate failed-send run establishes the lost response. Execution does not accept this draft example.
